reuse: IF07 C immutable source, full SIFT coordinates and precision gates; old 15 and N01-03, N04 old main deduplicated. No new visual pair computation. Existing thresholds from IF07 unchanged; independent transfer median <=3 px from IF07, 90th <=6 px. No angle or weight tuning.

models.rule: fixed overlapping source-PTS windows; sparse star in already verified IF07 local graph. Each valid model uses a reference and >=2 aligned views plus at least two points tracked across 3 views; confidence bounded by held-point residual and coverage. No scene ID input.

bridge.rule: All existing wide roots searched, including middle, across all fixed disjoint temporal window pairs. Cap deterministic spread by time and root count. B1 inserts one qualified direct edge per visited window pair into old graph; B2 uses the exact same source pool, train a cross-model transform from one pair, test a different frame-disjoint and disjoint-root pair. Cross-checked means geometry only. Report budget/no support/not evaluable distinctly; no extra source acquisition for B1 or B2; at most one fit per group.

judgment.rule: Run only when at least one independently validated B2 bridge. Side effects confined to reversible hypothesis mapping, never collapse time visits. Require each model supported by distinct stable legacy appearance episodes, independent short local registered motion spanning the gap, no verified separate/intermediate occurrence or accepted transition bracket across candidate, no unexplained edit, no evidence shared only by one location/patch. Classify conflicts as unknown and keep appearance/temporal separation; no inference of distinct physical room from lack of match. No product upgrade without independent new positive crossing.

state.rule: Use only existing reserved Psmall connected-component proposals. Inspect registered local patch and stable surrounding support across the same coarse pool. Scan both directions on each component, identify persistent plateau and distinct start/end; prefer preserving the existing lens when its appearance is the same. Preserve original change/intermediate image when adding endpoints within budget and preserve frozen P1 broad roles; avoid implicit endpoint or known-time selection. No new proposal detector or threshold search. Psmall and Pchain share proposals and 8 images; patch limit bounded by original recorded candidate work, count actual patch work. Qchain deferred.

replay: B0 run same IF07 short solver for all 32 frozen probes and check existing frozen 8 images/PTS/timing across 18; four-clip A1 replay of wide gates, old N04 shares base geometry. Actual 10fps historical-style source queries for all 18. Historical Pquery, P0, P1, Psmall, V/uniform explicitly linked.
stop: One locked pass. Source identity and code hashed before any predictions, labels only read by evaluator afterward. No new scene model, angle, training or Agent eval. No watch or source mutation.
